reference.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single transparent sprite reference for a small ordinary goblin scout enemy in a 2D mobile idle RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved forest boar style reference; Image 2 is the approved slime style reference. Match their simple flat spot colors, organic dark contour and minimal face details. Do not depict those creatures.
Primary request: One small green goblin in a plain brown leather hood and short brown tunic holding a small dagger, facing LEFT. An ordinary low-level enemy, not a boss or ornate hero. Squat compact body about two heads tall, no visible neck, very short plump arms and short legs ending in round dark-brown boots. Large simple green pointed ear protrudes from hood at the rear, a short blunt green nose projects LEFT, tiny dark dot eyes and a tiny neutral mouth. Plain hood is one simple rounded pointed shape. Two legs and two hands. The near hand (his right hand) holds the dagger low in front, pointed diagonally up-left. Empty far hand rests alongside the body. Hands touch their short arms; no floating limbs.
Style/medium: extremely simple flat 2D vector-style raster sprite, same contour weight and flat fill treatment as approved inputs; silhouette readable at a 48 pixel body height.
Color palette: only six flat colors: near-black #231B15 contour and eyes, green #70AA4D skin, brown #95603D hood and tunic, dark brown #593E2B boots/hood opening, muted silver #C8D0CC dagger, tan #C99B59 dagger grip. Every material is one solid flat color with no highlights or shade bands.
Composition/framing: exactly one full body, side-facing LEFT with slight three-quarter visibility sufficient to show both hands, neutral standing pose, feet aligned to one baseline, centered in a square, generous transparent margin. No cut off ears, boots or dagger.
Lighting/mood: unlit graphic, mildly cheeky and cute ordinary enemy.
Constraints: true transparent background, no ground shadow, no gradient, no grain, no texture, no glow, no detailed armor, no belts buckles pouches or straps, no fingernails/finger detail, no text, no logos, no border. Do not enlarge the dagger; it is shorter than the head height. Do not copy the boar silhouette onto the goblin.

clips.action: breathing idle loop. Frame 1: exactly the reference neutral standing pose. Frame 2: body slightly lower and wider, same expression, hands and dagger remain attached to arms and near torso. Tiny changes only.
clips.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2D game sprite animation strip.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact goblin scout identity and flat color style reference. Preserve its green skin, brown leather hood and short tunic, large pointed ear, short nose, tiny eyes, short limbs, dark brown rounded boots and small dagger.
Primary request: breathing idle loop. Frame 1: exactly the reference neutral standing pose. Frame 2: body slightly lower and wider, same expression, hands and dagger remain attached to arms and near torso. Tiny changes only.
Composition/framing: exactly 2 separate full-body frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW left to right. Same camera zoom in every frame; equal-width cells, large transparent gaps so frames never touch; all sprites face LEFT. Feet on one common baseline except explicit hop/fall. Entire hood ears boots and dagger inside each cell with generous margin.
Style/medium: minimal flat 2D raster sprite, broad solid spot-color shapes, clean dark contours of consistent weight, no material rendering, no dimensional shading.
Palette: exactly #231B15 contour/eyes, #70AA4D skin, #95603D hood/tunic, #593E2B boots/hood opening, #C8D0CC dagger blade, #C99B59 grip. No gradient in any surface; only antialiasing at color boundaries.
Constraints: true transparent background (the white reference backdrop is only for visibility and must not be copied). No text or numbers or panel borders or grid or logos. No ground shadow, no motion lines, no magic effects, no highlights, no texture. Anatomy has exactly two short arms and two short legs. Compact ordinary low-level enemy, not an ornate hero. No added clothing details or straps. Do not switch weapon hand.

clips.action: a calm readable walking loop IN PLACE to the LEFT, distinct alternating legs. Frame 1: near foot forward left and far foot behind right, both close to ground. Frame 2: feet passing under hips, body subtly higher. Frame 3: far foot forward left and near foot behind right, opposite stride to frame 1. Frame 4: other passing pose. Keep both legs visible as short legs, not four feet. Weapon stays in the SAME near/right hand close to the chest, dagger points up-left; empty far/left arm gently counter-swings. No running jumps, no wildly stretched limbs.

clips.correctionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: four-frame goblin dagger attack strip.
Input images: Image 1 is the attack strip to edit. Image 2 is the exact goblin identity reference.
Primary request: Fix ONLY frame 2 (the second goblin from the left) so the dagger stays in the SAME near/right hand as frames 1, 3, 4. Currently frame 2 mistakenly swaps dagger to the far hand on screen-right.
In frame 2: keep the empty far/left hand at screen-right next to hip. Put the dagger back in the near/right hand at screen-left in front of belly. For wind-up, that near hand moves just a little toward the middle of its belly, remaining IN FRONT of the tunic; elbow short and bent. Blade points diagonally up-left just below nose, never points right. Short knees slightly bent. The empty far hand does not hold anything.
Preserve frames 1,3,4; preserve all head/ear/hood shapes, colors, body proportions, frame sizes, direction and transparent gaps. Exactly FOUR frames in a single horizontal strip. No text. True transparency. Flat solid colors with no gradients, no lighting. No new details or detached dagger.
clips.correctionReason: 두 번째 프레임에서 무기를 반대 손으로 옮긴 오류를 수정.

clips.action: hit reaction. Frame 1: recoil slightly to the right, knees bent, tiny squeezed line eyes; small dagger remains firmly in the SAME near/right hand, boots remain planted. Frame 2: neutral reference standing recovery pose, tiny dot eyes open.

postprocess_approval: 앞선 사용자 승인인 Pillow 단색 평탄화를 같은 그림체의 후속 몬스터에 적용. 생성 원본과 알파 보존.

postprocess.normalization: 클립마다 중립 자세로 생성 줌을 맞추고, 클립 안에서는 공통 배율 사용. 걷기는 몸 높이 중간값으로 정규화.

verification.enter_note: 걷기 클립이 있어서 실제 전투의 등장은 walk로 재생. enter 2프레임은 에셋 참조와 프레임 미리보기로 확인.
verification.screenshot_note: 그림 확인을 위해 검증 계정의 튜토리얼 가림을 해당 플레이에서만 비활성화. 씬·프리팹 설정은 변경하지 않음.
verification.console_note: 게임 런타임 오류 없음. Unity CLI 상태 조회가 존재하지 않는 editor status 명령을 호출한 도구 로그는 별도 확인.

orientation.method: 각 정사각 프레임 내부만 수평 반전. 프레임 순서·알파·RGB 값을 그대로 유지.
